_comment: Editor-authored entity definitions merged over the generated ones by tools/gen_iw8_entity_defs.py (a class here replaces the generated class whole). Edit here, not in iw8_entity_defs.json.

light.description: Light: an omni, or a spot when it has a target or a fov key; built as a primary light (5.1); optional IES profile for spots.

_color.description: Light colour r g b, 0 to 1 (or 0 to 255); built into the primary light (compile_iw8.cpp localPrimaryLights).

origin.description: Position x y z in map units.

target.description: Aim the spot at the entity with this targetname.

angles.description: Aim (pitch yaw roll) when there is no target.

fov_outer.description: Full outer cone angle in degrees (1 to 170).

fov_inner.description: Full inner cone angle in degrees (below fov_outer).

iw8r_ies.description: LM-63 .ies light profile (absolute or relative to the map folder). The build writes it as the spot's own light definition (Replay IES segment, docs/research/38); in-game look not verified.

iw8r_bulb_radius.description: Bulb radius in map units, above 0 (converter default 1). Written as bulb_radius; widens the light's volume.

iw8r_shadow_bias.description: Shadow map bias (converter default 0.75). Written as shadow_bias.

iw8r_falloff.description: Distance falloff, above 0 (converter default 0.2). Written as distance_falloff.

iw8r_fade.description: Fade range 'near far': two numbers (converter default 0 0). Written as fade_offset.

iw8r_shadows.description: 1 gives the light a shadow map. Spot lights only; an omni ignores it. Written as can_use_shadow_map.

iw8r_intensity_units.description: Intensity in light units, 0 or more. Written as intensity: the converter uses it and skips the radius brightness calibration. Unset: calibrated from the radius.

iw8r_uv_intensity.description: UV vision intensity (converter default 0). Written as uv_intensity.

iw8r_ir_intensity.description: Thermal vision intensity (converter default 0). Written as ir_intensity.

iw8r_volumetric.description: 1 makes the lamp light the volumetric air: a glow around it and beams in fog. The game adds a lamp to the air only when it is flagged; stock maps flag their feature lamps, not every lamp. It shows only when the map has volumetric air (worldspawn iw8r_haze, or volumetricAirDensity in iw8r_vision). Written as volumetric. Research 126. Not seen in game.

light_spot.description: Spot light: built as a primary light (5.1) aimed at its target or along its angles; optional IES profile.

_color.description: Light colour r g b, 0 to 1 (or 0 to 255); built into the primary light (compile_iw8.cpp localPrimaryLights).

angles.description: Aim (pitch yaw roll) when there is no target.

origin.description: Position x y z in map units.

target.description: Aim the spot at the entity with this targetname.

fov_outer.description: Full outer cone angle in degrees (1 to 170).

fov_inner.description: Full inner cone angle in degrees (below fov_outer).

iw8r_ies.description: LM-63 .ies light profile (absolute or relative to the map folder). The build writes it as the spot's own light definition (Replay IES segment, docs/research/38); in-game look not verified.

iw8r_shadow_bias.description: Shadow map bias (converter default 0.75). Written as shadow_bias.

iw8r_falloff.description: Distance falloff, above 0 (converter default 0.2). Written as distance_falloff.

iw8r_fade.description: Fade range 'near far': two numbers (converter default 0 0). Written as fade_offset.

iw8r_shadows.description: 1 gives the light a shadow map. Spot lights only; an omni ignores it. Written as can_use_shadow_map.

iw8r_intensity_units.description: Intensity in light units, 0 or more. Written as intensity: the converter uses it and skips the radius brightness calibration. Unset: calibrated from the radius.

iw8r_uv_intensity.description: UV vision intensity (converter default 0). Written as uv_intensity.

iw8r_ir_intensity.description: Thermal vision intensity (converter default 0). Written as ir_intensity.

iw8r_volumetric.description: 1 makes the lamp light the volumetric air: a glow around it and beams in fog. The game adds a lamp to the air only when it is flagged; stock maps flag their feature lamps, not every lamp. It shows only when the map has volumetric air (worldspawn iw8r_haze, or volumetricAirDensity in iw8r_vision). Written as volumetric. Research 126. Not seen in game.

dynamic_prop.description: Physics prop (editor class, 6.15): the build writes it as converter clutter (a dynamic model with a physics preset) that falls and can be knocked around. In-game behaviour not verified yet.

origin.description: Position x y z in map units.

model.description: A custom model (models folder) or an exported stock model.

mass.description: Mass in kilograms; props up to 2 kg are debris.

material.description: Physics material word: wood, metal, plastic, glass, paper, rubber, brick, ...

iw8r_material.description: One material on every surface of this model (drag a material from the Materials browser onto the model). The build makes a copy of the stock model with that material; custom models keep their own materials.

iw8r_volume.description: Volumetric box (editor class, 5.7): a box of fog in the game's volumetric air, lit by the sun, the sky light and lamps with iw8r_volumetric. Density is extinction per unit (0.001 is a light haze, stock boxes hold 0.0002 to 0.04); falloff is the soft border in units. Mask pictures (mask .. mask4) break it into drifting patches. Game Lighting shows it. Seen in game only as part of a haze.

mins.description: Box corner relative to the origin.

maxs.description: Opposite box corner relative to the origin.

density.description: How thick the fog in the box is: extinction per world unit, added to the map's air. 0.0002 is a light haze, 0.001 the default (256 units let 77 % through), 0.005 thick; above 0.05 the build warns. Stock boxes hold 0.0002 to 0.04. Research 127.

falloff.description: The soft border in world units: the fog is full this far inside each face and fades to nothing at the face, with rounded corners. At most the box's smallest half size. Stock boxes use 8 to 20.

color.description: No effect in Replay 1.20: the game's volumetric pass does not read a box's color. Tint the air with the vision field volumetricAlbedo (iw8r_vision, or a haze preset).

height_fade.description: The game's own height value, 0 to 1 (it clamps): thickness x exp(-0.1 x height_fade x height above the box's bottom). height_half is the easier key and wins when both are set.

anisotropy.description: No effect in Replay 1.20: the game's volumetric pass does not read a box's anisotropy. Tint the air with the vision field volumetricSunAnisotropy (iw8r_vision, or a haze preset).

height_half.description: Height in units above the box's bottom (along the box's own up axis) where the fog is half as thick: a ground mist. 6.931 or more; empty = the same thickness at every height. Written as height_fade.

mask.description: A picture that thins the box's fog (white keeps it, black removes it): "<picture> [x|y|z] <sizeU> [<sizeV> [<scrollU> <scrollV> [<offsetU> <offsetV>]]]". The picture is projected through the box along the axis (default z, the box's up) and repeats every size units; scroll moves it, in units per second. Pictures: a file name without its ending from the map's volume_masks folder (PNG, TGA, JPG, BMP), or the editor's clouds_soft and clouds_hard. Game Lighting shows it. Up to four masks multiply (mask2, mask3, mask4): two cloud layers moving at different speeds look like drifting mist. Not seen in game.

mask2.description: A second mask picture, as mask. All masks of a box multiply.

mask3.description: A third mask picture, as mask.

mask4.description: A fourth mask picture, as mask.

misc_model.description: Static model placement: built as a world static model (custom or exported stock model) with convex hull collision.

angles.description: Pitch yaw roll in degrees. Stock values use the middle (yaw) slot (inferred from stock values).

model.description: xmodel name for point models; '*N' selects brush model N and is written by the compiler (inferred from stock values).

modelscale.description: Model scale factor (inferred from stock values).

origin.description: Position x y z in map units (inferred from stock values).

lod_scale.description: Scales this placement's LOD switch distances (Replay per-placement table: 0.25 to 4; stock maps often use 4). Written as the placement's lod_scale (research 54).

no_shadow.description: 1: the model casts no shadow: none from local (primary) lights (shadow_lights empty) and none from the sun (the fork's no_sun_shadow; research 54 / 60).

ground_lighting.description: Ground lighting: the placement is lit by one flat colour instead of the light grid. "1" = the converter's default grey; "r g b" (0..1, or 0..255) sets the colour (model_flags 1 + ground_lighting, research 54). Colour channel order in game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_spin.description: Spins without scripting: "<seconds per turn> [yaw|pitch|roll]". The map script turns it one full circle every that many seconds. A misc_model with this key is built as a live script_model; a missing targetname is filled in.

iw8r_bob.description: Bobs without scripting: "<height> [seconds]". The map script moves it up that many units and back down, once every seconds (default 2). A misc_model with this key is built as a live script_model; a missing targetname is filled in.

iw8r_material.description: One material on every surface of this model (drag a material from the Materials browser onto the model). The build makes a copy of the stock model with that material; custom models keep their own materials.

iw8r_no_collision.description: 1: the model has no player collision (it stays a live script_model; bullets still hit it). Used by Make Ladder so the ladder model does not stand between the player and the climbable brush. A misc_model with this key is built as a script_model.

script_brushmodel.description: Brush model whose surfaces scripts use, referenced as '*N' (contract 15 s3.5).

footprint_mask_group.description: Footprint mask group name (inferred from stock values; stock value 'default').

model.description: xmodel name for point models; '*N' selects brush model N and is written by the compiler (inferred from stock values).

nophysics.description: Disables physics on the entity (inferred from stock values).

origin.description: Position x y z in map units (inferred from stock values).

physasset.description: Physics asset name (inferred from stock values).

script_gameobjectname.description: Gameobject or objective id read by gsc gameobjects.gsc:17. Values such as bombzone and sd are inferred from stock values.

script_noteworthy.description: Free-form tag that gametype code branches on (gsc gametypes/arena.gsc:509-527, ammorestock.gsc:22-25).

spawnflags.description: Bit flags. Scripts test single bits (gsc gametypes/br_quest_util.gsc:1795, gametypes/br_dom_quest.gsc:71); per-class bit meanings are not sourced.

targetname.description: Name that other entities use to find this one (gsc ammorestock.gsc:8).

iw8r_door.description: Door without scripting. "hinge <angle> [time]": hangs on a hinge at one end and swings away from the player who presses Use near it; it stays open until used again. "rotate <angle> [time] [hold]": the same swing, closing by itself after the hold time. "slide <x> <y> <z> [time] [hold]": slides and comes back. Needs a targetname. A trigger_use or trigger_multiple whose target is the door opens it; without one the door gets its own use area (its bounds grown by 40 units).

iw8r_lift.description: Lift without scripting: "<dz> [time] [wait]". Needs a targetname; the map script moves it up dz units over time seconds, waits, moves it back down and repeats.

iw8r_spin.description: Spins without scripting: "<seconds per turn> [yaw|pitch|roll]". The map script turns it one full circle every that many seconds. A misc_model with this key is built as a live script_model; a missing targetname is filled in.

iw8r_bob.description: Bobs without scripting: "<height> [seconds]". The map script moves it up that many units and back down, once every seconds (default 2). A misc_model with this key is built as a live script_model; a missing targetname is filled in.

iw8r_brush_visual.description: Moving brush models are drawn by a generated model that the map script links to them (their own surfaces did not show in game). 0 turns this off for this brush model.

iw8r_hinge.description: Where a hinged door (iw8r_door hinge / rotate) turns. Without it the hinge is the end of the door's longer side with the lower coordinate. "far" takes the other end; "x y z" names the hinge point itself.

script_model.description: Point model placed by script. The model must exist as xmodel/<name>.json (contract 15 s3.6).

angles.description: Pitch yaw roll in degrees. Stock values use the middle (yaw) slot (inferred from stock values).

footprint_mask_group.description: Footprint mask group name (inferred from stock values; stock value 'default').

receivevolumedecals.description: Receives volume decals (inferred from stock values).

script_linkname.description: Link name read by gsc-raw animation_suite.gsc:124; role inferred from stock values.

iw8r_vision.description: Vision / fog inside this volume: "name=value; ..." Replay vision fields (as worldspawn iw8r_vision). Needs a targetname. A player inside sees it; leaving restores the map's vision. Research 63.

iw8r_teleport.description: Teleporter: the targetname of the destination (a script_origin). Needs its own targetname; a player touching the trigger moves to the destination's origin and angles.

iw8r_jump.description: Jump pad: "<vx> <vy> <vz>" launch velocity (units per second). Needs a targetname; a player touching the trigger is launched.

iw8r_damage.description: Damage zone: "<amount> [interval]". Needs a targetname; a player inside takes amount damage every interval seconds (default 1).

iw8r_audio_zone.description: Audio zone: a lower-case zone name. Inside this trigger's box the zone's reverb (iw8r_reverb) applies; written to the sound table and client triggers (research 63). In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_reverb.description: Reverb room type (one of the 59 stock types, e.g. iw8_md_room, iw8_ext_open_space_med_1; Help lists them in research 63) and optional dry wet fade: "<room> [dry wet fade]". The build writes the map sound table (in game NOT VERIFIED).

iw8r_audio_priority.description: Audio zone priority where zones overlap (higher wins; the map-wide zone is 0).

iw8r_audio_interior.description: 1: the zone uses the stock "interior" occlusion and filter presets (sounds behind walls muffled as indoors); 0: the stock "default" ones. Written to the sound table (research 63). In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_ambient.description: Ambient bed of the zone: the name of one of the map's own sounds (<map dir>/sounds/<name>.wav or .mp3), built into the map sound bank and played as a 2D loop while in the zone. Stock aliases cannot be used here (silent in the map bank); use a looping sound_emitter for those. In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_ambient_oneshots.description: Ambient one-shots of the zone: "<min s> <max s> <sound>[:weight] ..." with the map's own sounds (<map dir>/sounds); one of them plays at random every min..max seconds while in the zone. In game NOT VERIFIED.

worldspawn.description: World geometry and global map settings. One per map (contract 15 s3.1).

__smuid.description: Stable entity id written by the tooling (inferred from stock values).

_csm_bound_halfsize.description: Cascaded shadow map bounds half size (inferred from stock values).

audio_compile_umbra.description: Audio umbra compile flag (inferred from stock values).

northyaw.description: North yaw. The IW3 converter drops it and always writes 90 (contract 15 s3.2, s3.4).

objectgroupcost.description: Object group cost (inferred from stock values).

outdoor_only_maxs.description: Outdoor-only bounds maximum (inferred from stock values).

outdoor_only_mins.description: Outdoor-only bounds minimum (inferred from stock values).

precomputed_sky_illumination_diffuse_ref.description: Precomputed sky illumination diffuse reflectance (inferred from stock values).

rayguidemode.description: Ray guide mode (inferred from stock values).

skycolor.description: Sky colour r g b (kept by the IW3 converter, contract 15 s3.2; inferred from stock values).

skydomelighting.description: Sky dome lighting enable (inferred from stock values).

skylight.description: Sky light enable (inferred from stock values).

smallesthole.description: Smallest hole size (inferred from stock values).

smallestoccluder.description: Smallest occluder size (inferred from stock values).

suncolor.description: Sun colour r g b (kept by the IW3 converter, contract 15 s3.2; inferred from stock values).

sundirection.description: Sun direction (kept by the IW3 converter, contract 15 s3.2; inferred from stock values).

sunisprimarylight.description: Sun is the primary light (inferred from stock values).

sunlight.description: Sun intensity (kept by the IW3 converter, contract 15 s3.2; inferred from stock values).

tu0bakechanges.description: Stock flag, meaning unknown (inferred from one stock value).

uselmapcompression.description: Lightmap compression enable (inferred from stock values).

iw8r_bake_lightmaps.description: 1: the build bakes a lightmap for the world (5.11): the sky and the bounce of the sun and lights (the game draws the sun and the lights in real time on top), and the sun visibility. The converter turns it into the game's lightmap (offline proof tools/lightmap_bake_build_test.py; not seen in game).

iw8r_bake_sky.description: Lightmap bake: the sky light as "r g b intensity" (default a pale blue at 0.35 of the sun).

iw8r_lightmap_texel.description: Lightmap bake: world units per lightmap texel (grows by itself when the atlas does not fit 2048 x 2048).

iw8r_bake_rays.description: Lightmap bake: sky rays per texel (more rays: smoother ambient, slower bake; at most 1024).

iw8r_sun_shadow_range.description: Sun shadow cascade size multipliers sent to every player (sm_sunCascadeSizeMultiplier1 / 2); "0" turns it off. Longer values push sun shadows further.

iw8r_reverb.description: The map's reverb everywhere outside audio zones. Reverb room type (one of the 59 stock types, e.g. iw8_md_room, iw8_ext_open_space_med_1; Help lists them in research 63) and optional dry wet fade: "<room> [dry wet fade]". The build writes the map sound table (in game NOT VERIFIED).

iw8r_audio_interior.description: 1: the zone uses the stock "interior" occlusion and filter presets (sounds behind walls muffled as indoors); 0: the stock "default" ones. Written to the sound table (research 63). In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_ambient.description: Ambient bed of the zone: the name of one of the map's own sounds (<map dir>/sounds/<name>.wav or .mp3), built into the map sound bank and played as a 2D loop while in the zone. Stock aliases cannot be used here (silent in the map bank); use a looping sound_emitter for those. In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_ambient_oneshots.description: Ambient one-shots of the zone: "<min s> <max s> <sound>[:weight] ..." with the map's own sounds (<map dir>/sounds); one of them plays at random every min..max seconds while in the zone. In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_sun_sprite.description: Sun sprite and flare: "<size 1..64> [flare alpha 0..1] [blind darken 0..1] [glare lighten 0..1]". Draws a sun disc in the sky in the sundirection (size in 480-line virtual pixels, CoD-style), a lens flare when looking at it, and the blind / glare strength. Written to extracted/sun/<map>.sun (research 39). In game NOT VERIFIED.

iw8r_airspace.description: How far the map's visibility cell and occlusion data reach above (first number) and around and below (second number) the map's geometry, in units. Aircraft killstreaks and their cameras fly there; from a camera outside it the game draws no players or vehicles. The default is the reach of a stock map's occlusion data. "0" keeps the tight cell.

iw8r_gametypes.description: The game modes the game offers for this map, as ui_gametype names with spaces between them (war dm dom sd ctf ...). Left out, the editor lists the modes the map has spawns and objects for. Written to map.json as gameTypes; needs a client that reads it.

iw8r_script.description: The map's own GSC file (relative to the map folder). It must define user_main(), which runs after the load script. Edited in the Script dock.

iw8r_mode_dvars.description: Game mode settings the map's script sets at every start, 'name=value; name=value' (Tools > Game Modes > Carry in this map). Not seen in game.

iw8r_mode_rules.description: Game mode rules applied to every player at each spawn by the map's script, which runs after the game type's own start (research 91): health=<1..1000>; speed=<0.2..3>; weapon=<name>; ammo=infinite. Not seen in game.

iw8r_gametype_script.description: A game type of the map's own (research 91 / 92): a GSC file beside the map whose file name is the game type name. The build checks it (a new name, main(), calls only into stock scripts stored by number) and compiles it into the map zone; map.json lists the name. Tools > Game Modes > New game type script writes a template. Not seen in game.

iw8r_br.description: What a small map switches off in the Warzone (br) game type: nocircle, nogulag, skipdrop (Tools > Game Modes). Also marks the map as a Warzone map for scriptables and vehicles.

iw8r_loot_zone.description: The loot zone name of the map's loot points when no iw8r_loot_zone brush entity names one; the loot tables pick the loot by it (research 87).

iw8r_no_loot.description: 1 writes an empty loot list (removes all loot points of a stock Warzone map on Rebuild Stock Zone).

iw8r_collision.description: How the build keeps the map's collision: auto (streamed tiles for a map wider than 20000 units), one (one piece; also full) or tiles (the game's streamed collision tiles, research 90). Overrides Edit > Preferences > Build: collision.

iw8r_sun_color.description: Stock maps (11.6): the sun's new colour, linear r g b 0 to 16 (File > Relight Stock Map Sun). Rebuild Stock Zone writes it. Not seen in game.

iw8r_sun_direction.description: Stock maps (11.6): the sun's new direction, pitch yaw in degrees as sundirection (pitch -90 to -1, negative = above the horizon; stock mp_shipment -20.261 -15.4) (File > Relight Stock Map Sun). Rebuild Stock Zone turns the sun light and the vision's sun fog and bakes the map's sun shadow again (ACTS exports the static models); the lightmaps keep the old sun's bounce light. A wide map whose new shadow does not fit is cropped to the play space and a margin. Not seen in game.

iw8r_sun_intensity.description: Stock maps (11.6): the sun's new intensity (stock: mp_shipment 8.6, mp_br_tut 30.7). Rebuild Stock Zone writes it. Not seen in game.

iw8r_sky_from.description: Stock maps (11.6): use another stock map's sky (File > Relight Stock Map Sky). Rebuild Stock Zone carries its sky material (tw/sky_<map>) and puts it on this map's sky surfaces. The baked lighting stays. Not seen in game.

iw8r_stock_retexture.description: Stock maps: 'from=to; from=to' material swaps on the world surfaces. Rebuild Stock Zone carries each new material from the zone the material catalogue names (map materials only). Not seen in game.

iw8r_haze.description: The game's own fog and volumetric air: "<preset> [amount]". Presets: desert, clear, overcast, dusk, fog. Amount 0.1 to 4 (1 = as designed) scales how thick it is. The game fogs the map and the sky itself (distance and ground fog with a glow toward the sun, blended into the low sky), and fills the air with volumetric fog that the sun lights and shadows (light shafts) and lamps with iw8r_volumetric 1 glow in. It replaces iw8r_fog. Any single value can be changed in iw8r_vision (fog..., volumetric..., veilStrength), which wins over the preset. Map > Atmosphere edits it; Game Lighting previews it. Research 126. Not seen in game.

iw8r_sky_brightness.description: Brightness of the built sky, 0.1 to 16. A built map's sky is an 8-bit picture made from the stock sky, exposed so that its brightest clouds stay below white; most of a bright sky then looks dark beside sunlit walls. 2 doubles the sky (its brightest parts go to white), 0.5 halves it. Compile > Sun & Sky edits it; the viewport shows it. Not seen in game.

iw8r_mount_edges.description: Mount edges: where a player can rest a weapon on cover. The game mounts only on edges the map lists. The build finds them on the map's visible solid brushes and on the collision hulls of placed models: outside wall corners at least 32 units tall and ledge tops at least 16 units long, where nothing covers them and there is room to stand. Brushes side by side or stacked count as one wall. Clip brushes hide edges but give none. 1 (default): brushes and models. brushes: brushes only. 0: none. Not seen in game.

fx_origin.description: Stock effect placement: the map script plays the 'fx' (loadfx + playfx / triggerfx), repeating every 'delay' seconds.

angles.description: Pitch yaw roll in degrees. Stock values use the middle (yaw) slot (inferred from stock values).

delay.description: Seconds between repeats; empty plays once (effects) or loops (sounds with loop 1).

fx.description: Stock effect name (vfx/...), from the Effects browser.

origin.description: Position x y z in map units (inferred from stock values).

soundalias.description: A sound played at the effect: one of the map's own sounds (sounds folder) or a stock alias. Loops unless sound_loop is 0.

sound_loop.description: 1: the effect's sound loops. 0: it plays once each time the effect's delay passes (once only without a delay).

iw8r_damage.description: The effect hurts: "<amount> [radius] [interval seconds]". A player within the radius (default 48) takes that damage every interval (default 1 second). No trigger is needed.

iw8r_decal.description: A decal: a picture projected onto the surfaces inside a box (stains, paint, markings). The box is placed at the origin; its forward (X) axis is the direction the picture is projected and must point into the surface. Needs a converter with the decal producer (research 80 and 82). Not seen in game.

angles.description: Pitch, yaw, roll. Forward is the projection direction: for a floor decal use 90 0 0 (pointing down).

size.description: Depth, width and height of the box in map units. Depth is along the projection direction.

material.description: The decal picture: a material of your custom library (its alpha is the decal's shape), or the name of a stock decal material the game always has loaded.

opacity.description: How strong the decal is, 0 to 1.

feather.description: Soft fade toward the front and back of the box, 0 to 1.

draw_order.description: Which decal draws on top where two overlap: -4 to 3, higher on top.

uv_scale.description: Tiling of the picture across the box: two numbers above 0.

scriptable.description: A stock scripted object (a scriptable): the game's own object with built-in behaviour, placed by the name of its stock definition. A definition the game always has loaded is placed by name: hardpoint_chevron (the Hardpoint zone marker). Doors, traffic cones, cars and other world objects live in stock map zones: with Edit > Preferences > Real stock scripted objects turned on the build copies the stock definition with its models, collision and materials into your map; with it off they are left out with a warning. Every stock definition is listed in data/asset_catalog/iw8_scriptables.tsv. Needs a converter with scriptable instances (research 86). The Warzone buy station br_plunder_box (and the few other objects of the game's Warzone file) is placed by name on a map made for the Warzone game type. On a stock map, File > Edit Placed Objects shows the buy stations as these entities: move one, or copy one for an extra station. Not seen in game.

targetname.description: Name that script uses to find it. Stock Hardpoint chevrons carry the name of their zone's marker group.

iw8r_loot_point.description: A loot point: a place where the battle royale scripts may put loot (a weapon, armour, cash, a supply box). On a Warzone stock map, File > Edit Loot Points turns the map's own points into these entities; move, add or delete them and File > Rebuild Stock Zone writes them back. On your own map, place them where loot should appear under the battle royale game type. Not kept in the entity text: the build writes them into the map's loot table. Not seen in game.

origin.description: Where the loot lies (on the floor).

angles.description: Pitch, yaw, roll of the loot item or box.

loot_cluster.description: auto: the build picks the cluster by position (a free point when no cluster box holds it). free: a single point outside every cluster. cache: a loot cache (supply box) point. A number: that cluster of the stock map; a point moved out of its cluster's box is treated as auto. Your own maps have no clusters: only cache matters.

loot_zone.description: auto: the build picks the named zone of the stock map by position. A number: that zone (0 = none). Not used on your own maps.

loot_zone_name.description: Information only: the name of the stock zone the point was in when it was read.

script_struct_mp_atv.description: A Warzone vehicle spawn: a ATV (quad bike) appears here in a Warzone (br) match, as on the stock Warzone maps. The build carries the stock vehicle and its model from mp_br_quarry into your map. Keep the keys as they are; set origin and angles. Not seen in game.

origin.description: Where the vehicle stands (on the ground).

targetname.description: The name the Warzone scripts look for.

script_gameobjectname.description: The game types it belongs to.

iw8r_loot_cluster.description: A new loot cluster on a Warzone stock map: a box (the bounds of this entity's brushes) that groups the loot points inside it. File > Rebuild Stock Zone adds it after the map's own clusters; loot points inside it whose cluster is auto join it. The map's own clusters win where boxes overlap. Not kept in the entity text. Not seen in game.

iw8r_loot_zone.description: A new named loot zone on a Warzone stock map: a box (the bounds of this entity's brushes) whose name the loot tables pick the loot by. File > Rebuild Stock Zone adds it after the map's own zones; loot points and new clusters inside it take it. Use a name the map's loot tables know (a zone name of the map, e.g. map_quarry). Not kept in the entity text. Not seen in game.

name.description: The zone name the loot tables pick the loot by (lower-case letters, digits and '_'). Empty: the map's first zone name.

iw8r_remove_world.description: Stock maps: takes the stock world geometry inside this entity's brushes out on File > Rebuild Stock Zone (research 96). Each brush (or patch) is a box; every world triangle whose three vertices lie inside a box stops drawing in every pass, and the world collision triangles and brush hulls inside it go. The stock sun shadow is baked again without them (worldspawn iw8r_remove_world_sun keep: not). Static models are not world geometry: hide them with Hide Stock Props In Selection. What stays: the baked lighting under and around it, and the stock occlusion data (something behind a removed wall can be culled from some views). Use a tool texture. Not kept in the entity text; not built into own maps. Not seen in game.

render.description: 0 keeps the triangles drawn: only the collision inside the boxes goes (a walk-through wall).

collision.description: 0 keeps the collision: only the triangles inside the boxes stop drawing (an invisible wall).
